tool_input.command:
cd /srv/leakruns/0e407e31eb9a-t1/ws/data; S=/srv/leakruns/0e407e31eb9a-t1/tmp/claude-0/-srv-leakruns-0e407e31eb9a-t1-ws/94eda4fe-adb1-4c8d-8574-9501ff2fa5dd/scratchpad; cat > $S/prep.py <<'EOF'
# design_9672 준비: 코호트·결과·특징 테이블 구성 (학습/평가 없음)
import pandas as pd
D='/srv/leakruns/0e407e31eb9a-t1/ws/data/'
p=pd.read_csv(D+'patients.csv.gz')
a=pd.read_csv(D+'admissions.csv.gz',parse_dates=['admit_time','discharge_time'])
d=pd.read_csv(D+'diagnoses.csv.gz')
o=pd.read_csv(D+'orders.csv.gz',parse_dates=['order_time'])
l=pd.read_csv(D+'labs.csv.gz',parse_dates=['report_time'])
a=a.sort_values(['patient_id','admit_time']).reset_index(drop=True)
a['tp']=a.discharge_time
# outcome: 다음 입원 시작이 (tp, tp+30d]
a['next_admit']=a.groupby('patient_id').admit_time.shift(-1)
a['readmit_30d']=((a.next_admit>a.tp)&(a.next_admit<=a.tp+pd.Timedelta('30D'))).astype(int)
a['followup_complete']=a.tp+pd.Timedelta('30D')<=a.discharge_time.max()
a['n_prior_adm']=a.groupby('patient_id').cumcount()
a['los_h']=(a.discharge_time-a.admit_time).dt.total_seconds()/3600
a=a.merge(p,on='patient_id',how='left')
c=a[(a.age>=18)&(a.discharge_status!='died')].copy()
dx=d.assign(chf=d.icd_code.str.startswith('I50'),ckd=d.icd_code.str.startswith('N18')).groupby('admission_id').agg(n_dx=('seq','size'),dx_chf=('chf','any'),dx_ckd=('ckd','any'))
c=c.join(dx,on='admission_id')
def win(df,tcol):
    m=df.merge(c[['admission_id','admit_time','tp']],on='admission_id')
    return m[(m[tcol]>=m.admit_time)&(m[tcol]<=m.tp)]
od=win(o[o.order_type=='dialysis_order'],'order_time')
c['dialysis_ordered']=c.admission_id.isin(od.admission_id)
cr=win(l[l.test=='creatinine'],'report_time').sort_values('report_time').groupby('admission_id').value.last()
hg=win(l[l.test=='hemoglobin'],'report_time').groupby('admission_id').value.min()
c['cr_last']=c.admission_id.map(cr); c['hgb_min']=c.admission_id.map(hg)
cols=['admission_id','patient_id','family_id','tp','readmit_30d','followup_complete','dx_chf','n_dx','unit','los_h','n_prior_adm','sex','age','dialysis_ordered','dx_ckd','cr_last','discharge_status','hgb_min']
c=c[cols]; c.to_csv(__file__.replace('prep.py','analysis_table.csv'),index=False)
print(c.shape); print(c.isna().sum()[lambda s:s>0]); print('follow-up incomplete',(~c.followup_complete).sum())
print('family_id missing rows',c.family_id.isna().sum(),'patients',c[c.family_id.isna()].patient_id.nunique())
EOF
python3 $S/prep.py
